blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Brazil signed memoranda of understanding on cooperation in agriculture and livestock and on the enforcement of competition laws during President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s bilateral meeting on Saturday. Lula arrived in Manila on Friday for landmark two-day state visit and to serve as Guest of the Chair at the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17. He is the first sitting Brazilian president to make a state visit to the Philippines. READ: Brazil’s Lula eyes deeper Asean ties thru PH visit In […]...
